title: Skolem Problem for Linear Recurrence Sequences
exact_target: Can one always decide from a linear recurrence and its initial values whether any term of the resulting sequence is exactly zero?

sources.citation: Piotr Bacik, "Completing the picture for the Skolem Problem on order-4 linear recurrence sequences," TheoretiCS, Volume 4 (published 2 December 2025), DOI 10.46298/theoretics.25.28; arXiv:2409.01221.
